svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-4-transports" name="process-view-level-4-transports"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant S as Transport screen (mobile app)
 participant H as Data and polling (mobile app)
 participant C as API client (mobile app)
 participant GW as API gateway [PENDING]
 participant CT as REST controller (Transports)
 participant J as Import job (Transports)
 participant UC as Use cases (Transports)
 participant TC as Transport data client (Transports)
 participant T as Porto Digital [FIWARE]
 participant DB as Transports DB
 loop Scheduled import, every N seconds [PENDING]
 J->>UC: Import transport data
 UC->>TC: Fetch transport data
 TC->>T: Request [HTTPS, timeout]
 alt Valid response
 T-->>TC: Bus positions
 TC-->>UC: Transport data
 UC->>UC: Validate (required fields, times, stops)
 UC->>DB: One transaction (repositories): replace regular-line options, save import time
 else Timeout, error or invalid data
 TC-->>UC: Error or invalid data
 UC->>DB: Keep last valid data, record failed import (repositories)
 end
 end
 P->>S: Opens the transport screen
 S->>H: Start polling
 loop Every few seconds while the screen is open
 H->>C: Get next transport options
 C->>GW: GET transport options [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>CT: Forward
 CT->>UC: Get options of this event
 UC->>DB: Read regular lines and event shuttles (repositories)
 UC-->>CT: Options, time of the data, source status
 CT-->>C: 200 OK
 C-->>H: Options
 H-->>S: Updates the screen
 alt Source available
 S-->>P: Next options home, \"Data from HH:MM\"
 else Source unavailable
 S-->>P: Last valid data, \"Data from HH:MM\", warning, event shuttles still shown
 end
 end
 P->>S: Leaves the screen
 S->>H: Stop polling
 Note over UC,T: The transport source is never called inside a user's request

 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
